do_if.value: $Candidate.exists and $Candidate.isclass.gate and $Candidate.sector.exists and $Candidate.sector != $destination and $Candidate.exit.exists and $Candidate.exit.sector.exists and $Candidate.exit.sector != $Candidate.sector

$Story.$MissionAccepted? and @$Story.$Sector_Investigation.exists and @$Story.$Sector_Hyperion.exists and $Story.$Sector_Investigation != $Story.$Sector_Hyperion and (not @$Story.$Sector_Next.exists or @$Story.$Sector_Next == $Story.$Sector_Investigation) and (md.Story_Hyperion.Ch1_3_Investigate_Gates.state == cuestate.complete or md.Story_Hyperion.Ch1_3_Investigate_Gates.state == cuestate.waiting) and md.Story_Hyperion.Ch1_3_Hyperion_Sector.state == cuestate.waiting and not @$Story.$HyperionCloneShip.exists

$Gate.exists and ($Gate != @$Story.$Investigation_CorrectGate or $Gate.sector != $Story.$Sector_Investigation or not @$Story.$Sector_Next.exists or md.Story_Hyperion.Ch1_3_Investigate_Gates.state == cuestate.waiting)

debug_text.text: 'VCF Hyperion: relocating gate search from %1 to real gate sector %2 via the native route; no scan or chapter completion granted'.[$Sector.knownname,$Gate.sector.knownname]
'VCF Hyperion: preparing current sector search in %1 using real gate %2 to %3; waiting for the reset listener'.[$Sector.knownname,$Gate.debugname,$Gate.exit.sector.knownname]

do_elseif.value: not $Gate.exists and (not RouteState.$NoRouteNotice? or player.age ge RouteState.$NoRouteNotice)

debug_text.text: 'VCF Hyperion: no real connected gate route from %1 to %2; quest remains pending, retrying without creating gates or completing objectives'.[$Story.$Sector_Investigation.knownname,$Story.$Sector_Hyperion.knownname]

do_if.value: $Prepared and @$Story.hasmission and $Story.$MissionAccepted? and @$Story.$Sector_Investigation == $Sector and @$Story.$Sector_Next == $Sector and @$Story.$Sector_Hyperion.exists and $Sector != $Story.$Sector_Hyperion and md.Story_Hyperion.Ch1_3_Investigate_Gates.state == cuestate.waiting and md.Story_Hyperion.Ch1_3_Hyperion_Sector.state == cuestate.waiting and not @$Story.$HyperionCloneShip.exists

debug_text.text: 'VCF Hyperion: resumed current gate investigation in %1 after listener reset; no scan or reward granted'.[$Sector.knownname]
